international.title: Senior Tories urge Badenoch to drop Brexit talk in major strategy shift, sources say
international.summary: Exclusive: While PM pushes for EU reset, Tory leader is moving away from ‘divisive’ issue that defined party for years Kemi Badenoch has been advised by her team to limit the amount of time she spends discussing Brexit and Europe, the Guardian has been told, moving the Conservatives away from an issue that defined the party for many years. While the Tory leader still gives views on Brexit – in an opinion piece in the Daily Mail on Thursday she condemned Andy Burnham’s ongoing reset with the EU as a “backwards” move – sources say it is now seen as a second-order subject.
